svg.title: Series marks atlas: fifteen makers grouped by region
svg.desc: A tall atlas for Morioka, Mizusawa and Oshu, Yamagata, Kyoto and Omi, and Takaoka. Every maker row records characters and reading, mark location, method, broad date or generation context, and confidence. Mark alone is not authentication.
svg.text: SERIES MARKS ATLAS — EVIDENCE, NOT A SEAL CHART
Maker · characters/reading · location · method · broad date/generation/context · confidence

g.text: Location: low near spout, viewed inverted
Method: relief mark pressed into mould with wooden seal
Context: 13th- and 14th-head variants published; current use shown; zero whole-kettle pairs
Confidence: variants documented; isolated kettle uncertain
